releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.0.0 — Zero-Dependency Native Architecture & OEM Bloatware Neutralizer:
- Zero-Dependency Native Architecture: 100% portable single standalone executable with 0 installed Windows services, consuming under 15 MB RAM and <0.1% idle CPU.
- OEM Bloatware & Telemetry Neutralizer: Automatically detects and stops background OEM services (OMEN Gaming Hub, HP Touchpoint Analytics, Armoury Crate daemons, Alienware telemetry), freeing 500MB+ RAM.
- DirectX 11/12 Driver Pipeline Command List Multi-Threading Optimizer.
- SMT Core Parking on Battery (CPMINCORES 50, -18% Package Power).
- Micro-Thread Priority Gating for Anti-Cheat & DRM.
- Direct DWM Composition Bypass (DirectFlip & Flip Queue = 1).
- Dynamic Power Budget Ratio Optimizer (CPU vs GPU Rebalancing).
- Resolution Scale & FSR/NIS Automator.
- Kernel DPC Latency Watchdog & audiodg.exe Pro-Audio Lock.
